from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn

# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Gesamt bucket styling (employee-specific)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


GESAMT_OVER_BG = "light-dark(var(--mantine-color-red-0), rgba(250, 82, 82, 0.18))"
ABSENCE_HATCH = (
    "repeating-linear-gradient(135deg, var(--alloq-border-strong) 0 1px,"
    " transparent 1px 6px)"
)
ABSENCE_DOT = {
    "position": "absolute",
    "top": "4px",
    "left": "5px",
    "width": "5px",
    "height": "5px",
    "borderRadius": "50%",
    "backgroundColor": "var(--alloq-text-muted)",
}
ROW_DELETE_CLASS = "aq-row-delete"
ROW_DELETE_ON_HOVER = {
    f"& .{ROW_DELETE_CLASS}": {"opacity": "0"},
    f"&:hover .{ROW_DELETE_CLASS}, & .{ROW_DELETE_CLASS}:focus-within": {
        "opacity": "1"
    },
}


FREE_COLOR = "light-dark(var(--mantine-color-green-7), var(--mantine-color-green-3))"
OVERBOOKED_LABEL = "Überbucht"


def _gesamt_color(state: rx.Var[str]) -> rx.Var[str]:
    """Free days colour: red when overbooked, muted when full, green when free."""
    return match_str(
        state,
        (
            "over",
            "light-dark(var(--mantine-color-red-7), var(--mantine-color-red-3))",
        ),
        ("zero", "var(--alloq-text-muted)"),
        FREE_COLOR,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Employee block
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _employee_header_row(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    is_collapsed = PlanningStore.collapsed_employees.contains(emp.id)
    return grid_row(
        mn.box(
            mn.group(
                mn.group(
                    mn.action_icon(
                        rx.cond(
                            is_collapsed,
                            rx.icon("chevron-right", size=16, stroke_width=2),
                            rx.icon("chevron-down", size=16, stroke_width=2),
                        ),
                        variant="subtle",
                        color="gray",
                        size="sm",
                        on_click=PlanningStore.toggle_employee(emp.id),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                    ),
                    mn.text(
                        emp.last_name + ", " + emp.first_name,
                        size="sm",
                        fw="700",
                        c="var(--alloq-text)",
                    ),
                    gap="sm",
                    align="center",
                    wrap="nowrap",
                ),
                de_number(
                    emp.hours_per_week,
                    suffix="h/W",
                    size="xs",
                    c="var(--alloq-text-muted)",
                    fw="400",
                ),
                justify="space-between",
                align="center",
                wrap="nowrap",
                w="100%",
            ),
            style={
                **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
                **STICKY_LEFT_EMP_HEADER,
                "borderTop": "1px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)",
                "borderBottom": "1px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)",
            },
        ),
        rx.cond(
            is_collapsed,
            rx.foreach(emp.gesamt, _gesamt_value_cell),
            _employee_info_cell(emp),
        ),
        style=STICKY_BLOCK_HEADER,
    )


def _employee_info_cell(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    return block_header_info_cell(
        mn.group(
            mn.tooltip(
                mn.action_icon(
                    rx.icon("plus", size=14, stroke_width=2),
                    variant="subtle",
                    color="gray",
                    size="xs",
                    aria_label="Projekt zuweisen",
                    on_click=PlanningStore.open_add_project_for_employee(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                        emp.id,
                    ),
                ),
                label="Projekt zuweisen",
            ),
            mn.tooltip(
                mn.action_icon(
                    rx.icon("calendar-plus", size=14, stroke_width=2),
                    variant="subtle",
                    color="gray",
                    size="xs",
                    aria_label="Abwesenheit eintragen",
                    on_click=TeamState.select_employee_and_add_absence(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                        emp.real_id,
                    ),
                ),
                label="Abwesenheit eintragen",
            ),
            gap="xs",
            wrap="nowrap",
        ),
        background=EMP_HEADER_BG,
        end=[
            summary_stat("Geplant", emp.planned_days),
            summary_stat("Frei", emp.available_days, color=FREE_COLOR),
        ],
    )


def _project_label_cell(project: ObjectVar[ProjectAllocationRow]) -> rx.Component:
    return mn.box(
        mn.group(
            mn.box(
                style={
                    "width": "4px",
                    "height": "20px",
                    "borderRadius": "2px",
                    "backgroundColor": project.color,
                    "flexShrink": "0",
                },
            ),
            mn.text(
                project.name,
                size=ROW_LABEL_FONT_SIZE,
                c="var(--alloq-text)",
                truncate=True,
                flex="1",
                style={"minWidth": 0},
            ),
            rx.cond(
                project.role_short != "",
                mn.badge(
                    project.role_short,
                    size="xs",
                    radius="sm",
                    variant="filled",
                    color=project.role_color,
                    c=ROLE_BADGE_TEXT_COLOR,
                    fw="700",
                ),
                rx.fragment(),
            ),
            mn.box(
                mn.tooltip(
                    delete_dialog(
                        title="Projektzuweisung entfernen",
                        content=f"{project.code} — {project.name}",
                        on_click=PlanningStore.remove_project_from_employee_grid(  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                            project.emp_id, project.real_project_id
                        ),
                        icon_button=True,
                        color="red",
                        size="xs",
                        variant="subtle",
                    ),
                    label="Projekt entfernen",
                ),
                class_name=ROW_DELETE_CLASS,
                display="flex",
            ),
            gap="sm",
            align="center",
            justify="space-between",
            wrap="nowrap",
            w="100%",
        ),
        style={
            **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
            **STICKY_LEFT_BODY,
            "paddingLeft": "16px",
        },
    )


def _project_row_view(project: ObjectVar[ProjectAllocationRow]) -> rx.Component:
    return grid_row(
        _project_label_cell(project),
        rx.foreach(project.cells, editable_value_cell),
        attrs=grid_row_attrs(f"{project.emp_id}|{project.code}", project.emp_id),
        style=ROW_DELETE_ON_HOVER,
    )


def _absence_value_cell(cell: ObjectVar[GridCell]) -> rx.Component:
    has_absence = cell.value.to(float) > 0
    return mn.box(
        rx.cond(
            has_absence,
            mn.text(
                format_de(cell.value),
                size="xs",
                c="var(--alloq-text-muted)",
            ),
            mn.text("", size="xs"),
        ),
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            **week_cell_style(cell.week_key),
            "color": "var(--alloq-text-muted)",
            "backgroundImage": rx.cond(has_absence, ABSENCE_HATCH, "none"),
        },
    )


def _absence_row(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    return grid_row(
        mn.box(
            mn.text("Abwesenheit", size="xs", c="var(--alloq-text-muted)"),
            style={
                **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
                **STICKY_LEFT_BODY,
                "paddingLeft": "16px",
            },
        ),
        rx.foreach(emp.absence.cells, _absence_value_cell),
    )


def _internal_value_cell(cell: ObjectVar[GridCell]) -> rx.Component:
    """Internal days, shown only where they differ from the usual value."""
    return mn.box(
        rx.cond(
            (cell.value.to(float) > 0) & ~cell.is_default,
            mn.text(
                format_de(cell.value),
                size="xs",
                c="var(--alloq-text-muted)",
            ),
            mn.text("", size="xs"),
        ),
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            **week_cell_style(cell.week_key),
            "color": "var(--alloq-text-muted)",
        },
    )


def _internal_row(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    return grid_row(
        mn.box(
            mn.text("Interne Projekte", size="xs", c="var(--alloq-text-muted)"),
            mn.text(
                de_number(
                    emp.internal_days,
                    decimal_scale=2,
                    fixed_decimal_scale=True,
                    prefix="· ",
                    suffix=" / Wo.",
                ),
                size="xs",
                c="var(--alloq-text-muted)",
            ),
            style={
                "gap": "4px",
                **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
                **STICKY_LEFT_BODY,
                "paddingLeft": "16px",
            },
        ),
        rx.foreach(emp.internal.cells, _internal_value_cell),
    )


def _gesamt_value_cell(cell: ObjectVar[GesamtCell]) -> rx.Component:
    """Free days; overbooking is tinted, absence weeks carry a small dot."""
    is_over = cell.state == "over"
    return mn.box(
        rx.cond(cell.has_absence, mn.box(style=ABSENCE_DOT), rx.fragment()),
        format_gesamt(cell.value),
        custom_attrs={"title": cell.breakdown},
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            **week_cell_style(cell.week_key),
            "position": "relative",
            "backgroundColor": rx.cond(
                is_over, GESAMT_OVER_BG, current_week_bg(cell.week_key)
            ),
            "color": _gesamt_color(cell.state),
            "fontWeight": rx.cond(is_over, "700", "500"),
        },
    )


def _gesamt_row(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    return grid_row(
        mn.box(
            mn.text("Gesamt (frei)", size="12px", fw="700", c="var(--alloq-text)"),
            style={
                **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
                **STICKY_LEFT_GESAMT,
            },
        ),
        rx.foreach(emp.gesamt, _gesamt_value_cell),
    )


def _employee_block(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    is_collapsed = PlanningStore.collapsed_employees.contains(emp.id)
    return mn.box(
        _employee_header_row(emp),
        rx.cond(
            ~is_collapsed,
            mn.box(
                rx.foreach(emp.projects, _project_row_view),
                rx.cond(
                    ~PlanningStore.hide_internal,
                    rx.fragment(_internal_row(emp), _absence_row(emp)),
                    rx.fragment(),
                ),
                _gesamt_row(emp),
            ),
            rx.fragment(),
        ),
        empty_grid_row(),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Add project modal
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _add_project_modal() -> rx.Component:
    """Modal to assign a project to an employee from the grid."""
    return mn.modal(
        modal_form_layout(
            content=mn.flex(
                section(
                    mn.select(
                        name="project_id",
                        label="Projekt",
                        data=PlanningStore.add_project_options.to(list[dict[str, Any]]),
                        value=PlanningStore.add_project_selected,
                        on_change=PlanningStore.set_add_project_selected,
                        required=True,
                        searchable=True,
                        clearable=True,
                        left_section=rx.icon("folder", size=16),
                    ),
                    rx.cond(
                        PlanningStore.quick_create_active,
                        quick_project_fields(
                            name_value=PlanningStore.quick_project_name,
                            on_name_change=PlanningStore.set_quick_project_name,
                            code_value=PlanningStore.quick_project_code,
                            on_code_change=PlanningStore.set_quick_project_code,
                            on_create=PlanningStore.quick_create_project,
                            loading=PlanningStore.is_quick_creating,
                        ),
                        rx.fragment(),
                    ),
                    mn.select(
                        name="role_id",
                        label="Rolle",
                        data=PlanningStore.add_project_role_options.to(
                            list[dict[str, str]]
                        ),
                        required=True,
                        searchable=True,
                        clearable=True,
                        left_section=rx.icon("shield", size=16),
                    ),
                ),
                mn.space(height="2rem"),
                direction="column",
                gap="md",
                width="100%",
            ),
            footer=modal_footer(
                "Zuweisen",
                PlanningStore.close_add_project_for_employee,
            ),
            on_submit=PlanningStore.add_project_to_employee_grid,
            reset_on_submit=True,
        ),
        title="Projekt zuweisen",
        opened=PlanningStore.add_project_emp_id != "",
        on_close=PlanningStore.close_add_project_for_employee,
        size="md",
        centered=True,
        z_index=300,
        class_name=MODAL_CLASS,
        overlay_props={"backgroundOpacity": 0.5, "blur": 4},
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Legend
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _footer() -> rx.Component:
    return legend_footer(
        *week_legend_items(),
        legend_item(
            {
                "width": "18px",
                "height": "14px",
                "borderRadius": "3px",
                "backgroundColor": GESAMT_OVER_BG,
            },
            OVERBOOKED_LABEL,
        ),
        legend_item(
            {
                "width": "18px",
                "height": "14px",
                "backgroundImage": ABSENCE_HATCH,
                "boxShadow": "inset 0 0 0 1px var(--aq-border)",
            },
            "Abwesenheit",
        ),
        hint=EDIT_HINT,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main component
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def planning_grid() -> rx.Component:
    return rx.fragment(
        _add_project_modal(),
        absence_modal(on_submit=PlanningAbsenceState.create_absence),
        rx.cond(
            PlanningStore.is_loaded,
            mn.box(
                planning_excel_grid(
                    header_block(),
                    mn.box(
                        rx.foreach(PlanningStore.filtered_employees, _employee_block),
                    ),
                    grid_id="planning-grid-root",
                ),
                _footer(),
                style=VIEW_COLUMN_STYLE,
            ),
            mn.center(
                rx.hstack(
                    rx.spinner(size="3"),
                    mn.text("Lade Planung...", size="sm"),
                    align="center",
                    spacing="3",
                ),
                py="xl",
            ),
        ),
    )
"""Planning Project view: projects as top-level collapsible rows."""

from __future__ import annotations

import reflex as rx
from alloq_commons.components.excel_grid import grid_row_attrs
from alloq_commons.components.formatters import de_number
from alloq_commons.role_colors import ROLE_BADGE_TEXT_COLOR
from alloq_project.components.planning_shared import (
    CELL_BASE,
    EDIT_HINT,
    LABEL_CELL_BASE,
    ROW_LABEL_FONT_SIZE,
    STICKY_BLOCK_HEADER,
    STICKY_LEFT_BODY,
    STICKY_LEFT_EMP_HEADER,
    STICKY_LEFT_GESAMT,
    VIEW_COLUMN_STYLE,
    block_header_info_cell,
    current_week_bg,
    editable_value_cell,
    empty_grid_row,
    format_gesamt,
    grid_row,
    header_block,
    legend_footer,
    planning_excel_grid,
    summary_stat,
    week_legend_items,
)
from alloq_project.states.planning_grid_state import (
    EmployeeAllocationRow,
    PlanningStore,
    ProjectBlock,
    ProjectGesamtCell,
)
from alloq_project.states.planning_models import RoleTotal
from reflex.vars import ObjectVar

import appkit_mantine as mn

PROJ_HEADER_BG = "var(--alloq-surface-hover)"


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Project header row
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _role_total_badge(role: ObjectVar[RoleTotal]) -> rx.Component:
    """Role abbreviation with its planned person-days."""
    return mn.badge(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(role.code, span=True, fw="700", fz="inherit"),
            de_number(value=role.days, decimal_scale=2, fixed_decimal_scale=True),
            gap="4px",
            wrap="nowrap",
        ),
        size="sm",
        radius="sm",
        variant="filled",
        color=role.color,
        c=ROLE_BADGE_TEXT_COLOR,
    )


def _project_header_row(proj: ObjectVar[ProjectBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    """Collapsible project header with color indicator and name."""
    is_collapsed = PlanningStore.collapsed_projects.contains(proj.id)
    return grid_row(
        mn.box(
            mn.group(
                mn.action_icon(
                    rx.cond(
                        is_collapsed,
                        rx.icon("chevron-right", size=16, stroke_width=2),
                        rx.icon("chevron-down", size=16, stroke_width=2),
                    ),
                    variant="subtle",
                    color="gray",
                    size="sm",
                    on_click=PlanningStore.toggle_project(proj.id),  # ty: ignore[invalid-argument-type]
                ),
                mn.box(
                    style={
                        "width": "6px",
                        "height": "20px",
                        "borderRadius": "3px",
                        "backgroundColor": proj.color,
                        "flexShrink": "0",
                    },
                ),
                mn.text(
                    proj.name,
                    size="sm",
                    fw="700",
                    c="var(--alloq-text)",
                    truncate=True,
                    flex="1",
                    style={"minWidth": 0},
                ),
                mn.badge(
                    proj.state,
                    size="xs",
                    radius="sm",
                    variant="light",
                    color="gray",
                ),
                gap="sm",
                align="center",
                wrap="nowrap",
                w="100%",
            ),
            style={
                **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
                **STICKY_LEFT_EMP_HEADER,
                "borderTop": "1px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)",
                "borderBottom": "1px solid var(--alloq-border-strong)",
            },
        ),
        block_header_info_cell(
            summary_stat("Geplant", proj.planned_days),
            background=PROJ_HEADER_BG,
            end=[rx.foreach(proj.role_totals, _role_total_badge)],
        ),
        style=STICKY_BLOCK_HEADER,
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Employee row (nested under project)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _employee_label_cell(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeAllocationRow]) -> rx.Component:
    """Label cell for an employee row under a project."""
    return mn.box(
        mn.group(
            mn.text(
                emp.name,
                size=ROW_LABEL_FONT_SIZE,
                c="var(--alloq-text)",
                truncate=True,
                flex="1",
                style={"minWidth": 0},
            ),
            rx.cond(
                emp.role_short != "",
                mn.badge(
                    emp.role_short,
                    size="xs",
                    radius="sm",
                    variant="filled",
                    color=emp.role_color,
                    c=ROLE_BADGE_TEXT_COLOR,
                    fw="700",
                ),
                rx.fragment(),
            ),
            gap="sm",
            align="center",
            wrap="nowrap",
            w="100%",
        ),
        style={
            **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
            **STICKY_LEFT_BODY,
            "paddingLeft": "24px",
        },
    )


def _employee_row_view(emp: ObjectVar[EmployeeAllocationRow]) -> rx.Component:
    """One employee row within a project block."""
    return grid_row(
        _employee_label_cell(emp),
        rx.foreach(emp.cells, editable_value_cell),
        attrs=grid_row_attrs(f"{emp.emp_id}|{emp.project_code}", emp.project_code),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Project Gesamt row
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _project_gesamt_cell(cell: ObjectVar[ProjectGesamtCell]) -> rx.Component:
    """Aggregate capacity cell at project level."""
    return mn.box(
        format_gesamt(cell.allocated),
        style={
            **CELL_BASE,
            "backgroundColor": current_week_bg(
                cell.week_key, "var(--alloq-surface-muted)"
            ),
            "color": "var(--alloq-text)",
            "fontWeight": "600",
            "fontSize": "11px",
        },
    )


def _project_gesamt_row(proj: ObjectVar[ProjectBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    """Gesamt row showing total allocated per week for a project."""
    return grid_row(
        mn.box(
            mn.text(
                "Gesamt (allokiert)",
                size="12px",
                fw="700",
                c="var(--alloq-text)",
            ),
            style={
                **LABEL_CELL_BASE,
                **STICKY_LEFT_GESAMT,
                "paddingLeft": "24px",
            },
        ),
        rx.foreach(proj.gesamt, _project_gesamt_cell),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Project block (composed)
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def _project_block(proj: ObjectVar[ProjectBlock]) -> rx.Component:
    """One project block with collapsible employee rows."""
    is_collapsed = PlanningStore.collapsed_projects.contains(proj.id)
    return mn.box(
        _project_header_row(proj),
        rx.cond(
            ~is_collapsed,
            mn.box(
                rx.foreach(proj.employees, _employee_row_view),
                _project_gesamt_row(proj),
                empty_grid_row(),
            ),
            rx.fragment(),
        ),
    )


# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
# Main component
# ---------------------------------------------------------------------------


def planning_project_view() -> rx.Component:
    """Main project-aggregated planning view component."""
    return rx.cond(
        PlanningStore.is_loaded,
        mn.box(
            planning_excel_grid(
                header_block(),
                rx.foreach(PlanningStore.filtered_projects, _project_block),
                grid_id="project-view-root",
            ),
            legend_footer(*week_legend_items(), hint=EDIT_HINT),
            style=VIEW_COLUMN_STYLE,
        ),
        mn.center(
            rx.spinner(size="3"),
            h="300px",
        ),
    )

import json

from alloq_project.components.planning_gantt import planning_gantt
from alloq_project.components.planning_grid import (
    ABSENCE_HATCH,

    planning_grid,
)

from alloq_project.components.planning_shared import (
    CURRENT_WEEK_BG,
    EDIT_HINT,
    MONTH_START_BORDER,
    SHORT_WEEK_BG,
    legend_footer,
    legend_item,
)

import appkit_mantine as mn


def _js(text: str) -> str:
    """Text as the compiled component spells it (non-ASCII escaped)."""
    return json.dumps(text)[1:-1]


COMMON_LABELS = ("Aktuelle Woche", "Monatsbeginn", "Kurze Woche", "Ungespeichert")


def test_legend_item_renders_swatch_dict_and_label() -> None:
    rendered = str(legend_item({"backgroundColor": "red"}, "Rot"))

    assert '["backgroundColor"] : "red"' in rendered
    assert "Rot" in rendered


def test_legend_item_accepts_a_component_as_sample() -> None:
    rendered = str(legend_item(mn.text("1,00"), "Wert"))

    assert "1,00" in rendered
    assert "Wert" in rendered


def test_legend_footer_has_top_border_and_hint() -> None:
    rendered = str(legend_footer(legend_item({}, "A"), hint="Tipp"))

    assert '["borderTop"] : "1px solid var(--aq-separator)"' in rendered
    assert "Tipp" in rendered


def test_team_view_legend_explains_cell_styles() -> None:
    rendered = str(planning_grid())

    for label in (*COMMON_LABELS, "Wie Vorwoche", "Abwesenheit"):
        assert label in rendered
    for style in (CURRENT_WEEK_BG, SHORT_WEEK_BG, GESAMT_OVER_BG, ABSENCE_HATCH):
        assert style in rendered
    assert f'["borderLeft"] : "{MONTH_START_BORDER}"' in rendered
    assert _js(OVERBOOKED_LABEL) in rendered
    assert _js(EDIT_HINT) in rendered


def test_project_view_legend_explains_cell_styles() -> None:
    rendered = str(planning_project_view())

    for label in (*COMMON_LABELS, "Wie Vorwoche"):
        assert label in rendered
    assert _js(OVERBOOKED_LABEL) not in rendered
    assert _js(EDIT_HINT) in rendered


def test_absence_view_keeps_its_legend() -> None:
    rendered = str(planning_gantt())

    for label in ("Neu (ziehen)", "Feiertag", "Wochenende", "Heute"):
        assert label in rendered

from reflex.vars import ObjectVar


def _cells(values: list[float]) -> list[GridCell]:
    return [GridCell(week_key=f"w{i}", value=v) for i, v in enumerate(values)]


def _week(key: str, work_days: float = 5.0) -> WeekColumn:
    return WeekColumn(key=key, label=key, month_label="Okt 26", work_days=work_days)


# === build_weeks ===


def test_build_weeks_marks_first_week_of_each_new_month() -> None:
    weeks, _ = build_weeks(13)

    expected = [
        i > 0 and weeks[i].month_label != weeks[i - 1].month_label
        for i in range(len(weeks))
    ]
    assert [w.is_month_start for w in weeks] == expected
    assert any(expected)
    assert weeks[0].is_month_start is False


def test_build_weeks_marks_weeks_shortened_by_holidays() -> None:
    holiday = anchor_date() + dt.timedelta(days=2)

    weeks, _ = build_weeks(2, {holiday})

    assert weeks[0].work_days == 4.0
    assert weeks[0].is_short is True
    assert weeks[1].is_short is False

def test_mark_repeats_flags_values_equal_to_the_previous_week() -> None:
    cells = mark_repeats(_cells([5.0, 5.0, 5.0, 2.0, 2.0, 0.0, 0.0, 5.0]))
    assert '["is_repeat"]' in rendered
    assert "var(--alloq-text-muted)" in rendered
    assert '["justifyContent"] : "flex-end"' in rendered

    rendered = str(_gesamt_value_cell(ObjectVar("cell", GesamtCell)))

    assert '"over"' in rendered
    assert "red" in rendered
    assert "blue" not in rendered
    assert '["breakdown"]' in rendered
    assert '["has_absence"]' in rendered


def test_work_days_header_shows_only_short_weeks() -> None:
    rendered = str(work_days_cell(ObjectVar("week", WeekColumn)))

    assert '["is_short"]' in rendered


def test_internal_row_hides_the_usual_value() -> None:
    rendered = str(_internal_row(ObjectVar("emp", EmployeeBlock)))

    assert '["is_default"]' in rendered
    assert '["internal_days"]' in rendered


def test_collapsed_employee_header_shows_gesamt_cells() -> None:
    rendered = str(_employee_header_row(ObjectVar("emp", EmployeeBlock)))

    assert '["gesamt"]' in rendered
    assert "collapsed_employees" in rendered
    assert "Überbucht" not in rendered

entries.name: mcp__ccd_session_mgmt__list_sessions
entries.description:
List the user's other CCD sessions (active and optionally archived).

Returns a compact JSON array sorted by most recent activity. The current session is excluded. Use this to answer "what other sessions do I have", to find a session by title/branch/PR/sidebar group, or — after a PR you opened has merged — to locate the corresponding session and offer to archive it via archive_session.

`permissionMode` (default, acceptEdits, plan, auto or bypassPermissions) is reported only for sessions this session started; other rows omit it. A linked session (one Claude started from another with start_session, or a linked fork) also carries `name` — the short handle its family calls it by — and `startedBy`, the id of the session that started it; pass {"linked": true} to list only your own family. `group` is the custom sidebar group the user filed a session under ({id, name}), or null when it is ungrouped. The key is omitted while the app window has not reported groups yet — treat that as unknown, not ungrouped. `pinned` is true or false per the sidebar pin (a pinned session keeps its group but is shown under Pinned); the key is omitted when the app has never recorded a pin for the session — read that as not pinned. To change either, use the ccd_sidebar tools when they are available (move_sessions, set_pinned, create_group, ...).

`link` opens the session in this app from outside it — use it in text that leaves this conversation (a PR description, Slack, a file); in your replies here, link a session as [its title](#<sessionId>) instead. Omitted when the organization turned app links off. `remoteControlActive` says Remote Control is serving the session to claude.ai/code (the user opens it from the Remote Control badge; its address is not given to you).

Pass include_archived: true to find archived sessions to restore (unarchive_session) or remove for good (delete_session, which asks the user first in every permission mode).

include_archived.description: Include sessions already archived. Default false.

limit.description: Max sessions to return (most recent first). Default 20.

group.description: Only sessions in this custom sidebar group (group id or exact name).

linked.description: Only this session's linked family: the session that started it, the sessions it or they started, and their own linked sessions. Default false.

---
name: planning-header-needs-table-width
description: Sticky header boxes in the planning scroll grids need width = table width, or their background stops at the viewport
metadata:
  type: project
---

In the planning views, the sticky header wrapper (`header_block` in `planning_shared.py`, `_header` in `planning_gantt.py`) sits inside a horizontally scrolling container. Without an explicit width it is only as wide as the viewport, so after scrolling right the header background turns white past that point. Rows are wider (`PlanningStore.table_width` / gantt `_total_width()`), so the wrapper must get the same width.

**Why:** found 2026-10-18 when the grid header moved from per-cell blue backgrounds to one shared muted background (week header unified with the absence view).
**How to apply:** any new sticky band (header, summary row) in these grids gets `width` set to the table width, not just per-cell backgrounds. Check by scrolling right in the running app.

All three planning views now have the same week header as Abwesenheiten: a month row, then each week with its KW number, start date and an orange dot for weeks with a holiday. The current week is highlighted the same way, and hovering a week shows the same tooltip (for example "KW 52 · ab Mo 21.12.2026 · Feiertag 24.12., 25.12."). All 1177 tests pass, and lint and the type check are clean. I checked Team, Projekte and Abwesenheiten in the running app. Nothing is committed.

**What changed**
- [planning_shared.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_shared.py) now holds two shared pieces, `month_head` and `week_head`. The absence timeline ([planning_gantt.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_gantt.py)) and the grid header of Team and Projekte both use them.
- The left header column now reads like the absence view: "Mitarbeiter / 8 Personen" in Team and "Projekt / 5 Projekte" in Projekte.
- The tooltip text comes from one function, `week_title` in [planning_builders.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/services/planning_builders.py), so both headers show the same text.

**Decision for you:** I removed the third header row in Team and Projekte, "Arbeitstage (brutto)", because the absence header doesn't have it. Short weeks now show only as the holiday dot plus the tooltip. In the legend, "Kurze Woche" became "Woche mit Feiertag". If planners need the work-day count visible all the time, I can add that row back under the shared header.

**Found while checking in the app:** after scrolling right, the grey header background stopped partway and the rest went white. I fixed it by making the header as wide as the table, and added a test for it.

**Two other things:**
- Two legend tests from the earlier legend session were already failing before I started. They expected a "Monatsbeginn" entry that the code never had. I changed them to match the current legend.
- While I worked, the "Absence view removal" session ran a git stash and reset on this same checkout. It didn't affect these changes, but parallel sessions sharing one folder can step on each other.

content.text:
Holidays now show as plain day bands in all three views, in one light amber colour. Each band covers exactly the holiday's day within the week column, for example Thursday and Friday in KW 52 (24./25.12.). All 1181 tests pass, lint and the type check are clean, and I checked it in the running app. Nothing is committed.

- **Team and Projekte:** the bands are part of each week cell's background, so they sit behind the numbers. They appear in every row: project rows, Interne Projekte, Abwesenheit and Gesamt. Cells with an absence keep their own stripe pattern, with the holiday band underneath it.
- **While editing:** the edit field covers the whole cell with a solid background, so the band is hidden while you type. I opened the editor on a holiday cell in the app to confirm this.
- **Abwesenheiten:** the striped pattern is gone; holidays use the same plain colour as the other views.
- **Legend:** both legends now show the plain swatch as "Feiertag". The small orange dot in the week header stays.

I chose the colour so it stays clearly different from the pale yellow of the current week. If you want it stronger or a different tone, it is one value, `HOLIDAY_BG` in [planning_shared.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/components/planning_shared.py).

The day positions per week are worked out in the state, in `holiday_backgrounds` in [planning_display_mixin.py](components/alloq-project/src/alloq_project/states/planning_display_mixin.py), using the holiday list from `build_weeks`.
